2607.02368.title: The Dual Nature of LLM Persona: Aggregated Tendencies and Frame-Dependent Geometry
2607.02368.paper_summary: Evaluations of LLM personas via psychometric questionnaires typically rely on aggregate scores, discarding within-instance correlation structure. We test whether this geometric structure is intrinsic or frame-dependent. Constructing within-instance correlation matrices from IPIP-50 responses, we analyze geometry on SPD manifolds under manipulated question orderings in GPT-4o simulating American and Chinese-American personas. We find that persona expression comprises two dissociable components: aggregated features (Big Five scores) degrade under randomization (21% drop) but are frame-robust; geometric features (SPD manifold) collapse under frame misalignment (42% drop) but recover substantially (to 84%) under shared frames, surpassing aggregated features (76%). This collapse-recovery pattern reveals that persona geometry is not intrinsic but a frame-dependent coordination pattern encoding information invisible to aggregation. Our findings establish a dual-nature framework for LLM personas, frame-dependent geometry versus frame-robust aggregates, necessitating frame-aware evaluation and challenging static trait conceptions.
2607.02368.paper_summary_zh: 評估LLM角色的心理測量問卷通常依賴於總體分數，忽略了實例內的相關結構。<lb/>我們測試這種幾何結構是內在的還是依賴於框架的。<lb/>從IPIP-50的回應中構建實例內的相關矩陣，我們分析在操控問題順序下的SPD流形幾何，模擬美國和華裔美國角色。<lb/>我們發現角色表達由兩個可分離的組成部分組成：聚合特徵（大五人格分數）在隨機化下下降（21%的降幅），但對框架穩健；幾何特徵（SPD流形）在框架不對齊下崩潰（42%的降幅），但在共享框架下顯著恢復（達到84%），超過聚合特徵（76%）。<lb/>這種崩潰-恢復模式顯示角色幾何不是內在的，而是一種依賴於框架的協調模式，編碼了聚合不可見的信息。<lb/>我們的發現為LLM角色建立了一個雙重性框架，即依賴於框架的幾何與穩健的聚合，這需要框架意識的評估，並挑戰靜態特質的概念。
